title: The AI workflow that eliminated my note-taking entirely
author: Sufficient_Net_4138
selftext:
Found a workflow that turned one lecture into a complete study pack 

    with zero handwriting:

    1. Record lecture audio on my phone (just leave it on the desk)

    2. Transcribe it (free tools do this in minutes)

    3. Feed the transcript into an AI chat → get a clean study guide

    4. Ask it "quiz me one question at a time and critique my answers"

    5. Then "convert this to Anki format" → import → instant flashcard deck

    One 2-hour lecture = notes + quiz + flashcards in about 15 minutes 

    of actual work.

    Anyone else built their study workflow around AI, or am I 

    overengineering this?
